name: mk-cc-all
description: All currently-active mk-cc-resources skills in one install: essense-flow (the pipeline), elicit (brainstorm a vision to completion), prism (the multi-perspective panel), kb (the project knowledge base — ask before re-deriving), schema-scout, project-note-tracker, session-lifecycle, and plugin-toolkit. Plugins that carry HOOKS must be installed separately — essense-autopilot, thorough-mode, alert-sounds, turn-end, reuse-gate, steward, patterns, and kb (the bundle ships kb's skills only; its hooks and MCP server need the standalone install, and patterns' catalog travels only in its own install). verifiability-lens no longer carries a hook — its automatic firing comes from turn-end's quality-lens duty. Benched plugins are preserved on the archive/benched-plugins branch.
